title: OpenWrtSecurityVulnerabilityRegistry
description: Evidence-based CVE and security vulnerability tracking registry for OpenWrt core, packages, and networking drivers.

cve_id.description: Standardized Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) identifier.

title.description: Concise summary title of the security vulnerability.

component.description: Affected software package, subsystem, or driver (e.g. 'dnsmasq', 'hostapd', 'luci', 'u-boot', 'kernel/mac80211', 'dropbear').

affected_versions.description: Explicit range of affected upstream software versions.

fixed_in.description: Earliest OpenWrt version containing backported or upstream fix.

advisory_url.description: Authoritative link to OpenWrt Security Advisory, NVD, or upstream CVE report.

description.description: Technical description of vulnerability mechanics, attack vector, and potential impact.

workaround.description: Documented configuration workaround, firewall rule, or package mitigation.

applicable_architectures.description: Hardware architectures or SoC families affected (leave empty if architecture-independent).

last_audit_date.description: Date of latest verification against NVD / OpenWrt advisory in YYYY-MM-DD format.
